title: Fix filter operators broken across spec and memory driver
body:
Comprehensive fix for filter operators (`contains`, `notContains`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`, `between`, `null`) that were broken or inconsistent across the spec definitions and memory driver. The critical root cause: `parseFilterAST()` converts AST operators to `$`-prefixed FilterCondition format (`$contains`, `$startsWith`, etc.), but the memory driver's `convertToMongoQuery()` passthrough branch sent these directly to Mingo — which doesn't understand them. All string/range/null filters returned empty results. ### Changes **Spec — `filter.zod.ts`** - **`StringOperatorSchema` / `FieldOperatorsSchema`** — add `$notContains: z.string().optional()` - **`VALID_AST_OPERATORS`** — add `notcontains`, `not_contains` - **`AST_OPERATOR_MAP`** — map both aliases → `$notContains` - **`FILTER_OPERATORS`** — add `$notContains` to the const tuple - **`Filter`** — add `$notContains` to the generic type **Memory Driver — `memory-driver.ts`** (Bug 1 root cause fix) - Replace `convertToMongoQuery()` passthrough (`return filters`) with `normalizeFilterCondition()` that recursively translates non-standard operators to Mingo-compatible format: - `$contains` → `$regex` (case-insensitive) - `$notContains` → `$not: { $regex }` (case-insensitive) - `$startsWith` → `$regex` with `^` anchor - `$endsWith` → `$regex` with `$` anchor - `$between` → `$gte` / `$lte` - `$null: true/false` → `$eq: null` / `$ne: null` - Handle multiple regex-producing operators on the same field (e.g. `{ $startsWith: 'A', $endsWith: 'n' }`) by promoting to `$and` so no regex silently overwrites another - Add `notcontains` / `not_contains` to `convertConditionToMongo()` for legacy AST format **Memory Matcher — `memory-matcher.ts`** - Add `$notContains` operator to `checkCondition()` - Add `$null` operator to `checkCondition()` - Fix undefined value guard to exclude `$null` so `$null: true` correctly matches records where the field is missing ```typescript // Before: Mingo doesn't understand $contains → empty results parseFilterAST(['name', 'contains', 'Evan']) // → { name: { $contains: 'Evan' } } ← passed to Mingo as-is, returns [] // After: normalized to Mingo-compatible format // → { name: { $regex: /Evan/i } } ← Mingo matches correctly ``` ### Tests - 2 new spec tests for `$notContains` schema validation and AST parsing - 16 new memory driver tests covering `$contains`, `$notContains`, `$startsWith`, `$endsWith`, `$between`, `$null` via FilterCondition object format, including `$and`/`$or` logical combinations, combined `$startsWith` + `$endsWith` on the same field, and `$null: true` on records with missing fields ### Cross-repo note This addresses bugs 1–3 from the audit (driver passthrough, missing `notContains`, `startsWith`/`endsWith` normalization) plus `$between` and `$null` handling. Bugs 4–7 (`isEmpty` rendering, `between` dual-input UI, `in`/`notIn` expansion, `DataScopeManager` case sensitivity) are frontend concerns that require coordinated changes in `objectui`.
Original prompt ---- *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* [Bug] Filter operators (contains, notContains, isEmpty, between) broken or inconsistent across frontend and server ## Summary The `contains` text search filter returns no results while `equals` works correctly (see screenshot). After a thorough code audit, **7 related filter issues** were identified across the `objectui` and `spec` repos. ## Root Cause Analysis **Bug 1 (Critical):** `contains` filter returns empty results — Server-side double-conversion - Frontend sends AST: `['name', 'contains', 'Evan']` - Server `parseFilterAST()` converts to `{ name: { $contains: 'Evan' } }` - Driver receives `{ name: { $contains: 'Evan' } }` but does not translate `$contains` → database-native (SQL/Mongo regex) - Results are always empty. **Other issues:** - `notContains` operator missing from mapping tables - `isEmpty`/`isNotEmpty` only matches null, not empty strings - `between` filter renders only one input, needs min/max - Case sensitivity inconsistency (`contains`) - `in`/`notIn` operator expanded in frontend; drivers support natively - Same double-conversion bug for `startsWith`/`endsWith` ## Proposed Fixes - Remove or refactor `parseFilterAST()` call and let drivers process raw AST arrays - Ensure drivers (esp. Memory & SQL) correctly convert `$contains`, `$startsWith`, `$endsWith`, `$notContains` to native DB queries - Update frontend FilterBuilder for correct input rendering & operator mapping ## Reproduction 1. ListView/Contact, filter Name with Contains, value = 'Evan' 2. No items found; Equals with exact value works ## Affected Files - objectui and spec repos, details in full analysis ## Cross-Repo Impact Requires coordinated changes in both objectui and spec repositories (especially data engine drivers). ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) @hotlong Let me do a thorough audit of all filter-related code paths to identify any similar issues before creating a comprehensive issue. 好的，我已经完成了对两个仓库中所有过滤相关代码的全面排查。下面我来总结所有发现的问题，然后创建一个合并的任务。 ## 🔍 全面排查结果 ### 问题 1（原始报告）：`contains` 过滤器在服务端不工作 **数据流完整追踪：** 1. **前端 FilterBuilder** → 用户选择 `Contains`，生成 `operator: 'contains'` ✅ 2. **ListView `mapOperator()`** → `'contains'` → `'contains'` ✅ 3. **ObjectStackAdapter** → 序列化 `['name', 'contains', 'Evan']` 为 JSON 发送 ✅ 4. **服务端 `parseFilterAST()`** → `['name', 'contains', 'Evan']` → `{ name: { $contains: 'Evan' } }` ✅ 5. **🔴 `toQueryAST()`** → 直接透传 `options.filter` 到 `ast.where`，此时 filter 已经被 `parseFilterAST` 转换成了 `{ name: { $contains: 'Evan' } }` 这种 MongoDB 对象格式 6. **🔴 Driver `convertToMongoQuery()`** → 接收到的是 **已转换的对象格式**，走 `MongoDB format passthrough` 分支直接返回 `{ name: { $contains: 'Evan' } }` 7. **🔴 Mingo 查询引擎** → Mingo **不认识 `$contains` 操作符**！Mingo 使用 `$regex` 做模糊匹配，所以查询返回空���果。 **根因**：`parseFilterAST` 将 AST `contains` 转换为 `$contains`，但 Mingo 不支持 `$contains`。Memory Driver 的 `convertConditionToMongo` 方法能正确处理 `contains` → `$regex`，但 **passthrough 分支跳过了这个转换**。 ### 问题 2：`notContains` 操作符缺失 AST 映射 ```typescript name=normalize-quick-filter.ts url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/fedefab4f44d9fa0bdd948594477e948e8a4442f/packages/core/src/utils/normalize-quick-filter.ts#L24-L43 function mapSpecOperator(op: string): string { switch (op) { case 'contains': return 'contains'; case 'notContains': return 'notcontains'; // ... } } ``` `notcontains` 在 `parseFilterAST` 的 `AST_OPERATOR_MAP` 中 **没有映射**： ```typescript name=filter.zod.ts url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/spec/blob/85735f159ebed7955f5c385dc34e4a1a3c779ef8/packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts#L389-L485 const AST_OPERATOR_MAP: Record = { 'contains': '$contains', 'like': '$contains', // ❌ 缺少 'notcontains' 映射！ }; ``` `notcontains` 会走 fallback 变成 `$notcontains`，而 Driver 同样不认识。 ### 问题 3：`startswith` 操作符大小写不一致 前端 `mapOperator` 中没有 `startsWith`/`endsWith` 映射（FilterBuilder 未暴露这些操作符给用户），但 `VALID_AST_OPERATORS` 中同时存在 `startswith` 和 `starts_with`： ```typescript name=filter.zod.ts url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/spec/blob/330ad325ffe017e917b1b09d79b31fe599ddf677/packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts#L252-L356 export const VALID_AST_OPERATORS = new Set([ 'contains', 'like', 'startswith', 'starts_with', 'endswith', 'ends_with', ]); ``` 而 Memory Driver `convertConditionToMongo` 处理了 `startswith`/`starts_with`，但 `AST_OPERATOR_MAP` 映射到的是 `$startsWith`（驼峰），如果 filter 对象格式被 passthrough，Mingo 同样不认识。 ### 问题 4：`isEmpty`/`isNotEmpty` 的 null 转换可能导致意外行为 ```typescript name=ListView.tsx url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/fedefab4f44d9fa0bdd948594477e948e8a4442f/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx#L94-L193 function convertFilterGroupToAST(group: ...
